related_issues.reason: Earlier report of uv pip install running out of memory with many dependencies (open, performance, needs-mre); similar symptom but different command.

rationale: Reporter labelled this a question, but uv sync growing until OOM-kill on a public workspace (DB-GPT) on 0.11.7 is a performance/memory defect rather than misuse; uv has no documented memory-limit setting that I verified (docs not searched). Searches only surfaced #7004 (OOM with uv pip install, open) as related context, not an exact duplicate. A plausible alternative is that it is a question/enhancement about limiting memory, or that the multi-index setup contributes.
